title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast 6000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit
description: The DOJO BLAST 6000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit from Vaporesso combines outstanding flavours, effortless convenience and exceptional performance in one remarkable device. Designed with both new and experienced adult vapers in mind, this innovative device fuses the simplicity of disposable vapes with the reusability and cost-saving value of rechargeable and refillable systems. There are 15 flavours to choose from, with seven stylish, brushed metallic colours reflecting the flavours, in the collection. The DOJO BLAST 6000 features a rechargeable 650mAh battery, Vaporesso’s cutting-edge COREX2.0 mesh coil technology for superior flavour and vapour production, and a unique dual-mode functionality that lets you switch between Normal and Turbo modes to suit your vaping preferences with the press of a button. Each kit includes a 2ml pod and a 10ml e-liquid refill bottle, both prefilled filled with smooth and satisfying nicotine salt 20mg e-liquid. Together, they together can provide up to 6000 puffs (dependent upon personal usage) of rich, flavoursome vapour – far more than traditional single-use disposable vapes. The transparent pod design lets you monitor your e-liquid levels with a glance, ensuring you never run dry. The innovative top-to-bottom refilling structure maximises coil saturation, delivering consistent flavour and vapour with every puff. When your refill pod and bottle runs dry, choose from 15 Dojo blast flavours available in handy and affordable refill packs. The DOJO BLAST 6000 offers a vaping experience you can tailor to your exact tastes. Whether you enjoy fruity, menthol, or totally unique flavour profiles, there's a DOJO BLAST 6000 kit and flavour for you. Device Flavours: Watermelon Ice: The delicately sweet and refreshing taste of juicy watermelon flavour with a cool menthol finish. Ten Tangerines: A sweet and tangy burst of juicy, ripe tangerine flavours. Sweet Grape : The rich and sweet flavour of plump, juicy, freshly picked grapes Straw-Raspberry Cherry Ice : A medley of strawberry, raspberry, and cherry flavours given a cool icy finish. Pineapple Ice : Experience the tropical and tangy taste of pineapple enhanced with a refreshing menthol finish. Peanut Chocolate: A unique blend of smooth peanut and rich chocolate flavours. Menthol : A classic, cool, clean menthol flavour for the ultimate refreshing vape. Lemon & Lime: The timeless citrus duo of sharp, tangy lemon and zesty, vibrant lime. Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava: An exotic, tropical cocktail of kiwi, passion fruit, and guava flavours. Fizzy Cherry : A tangy and sweet cherry flavour with a subtle burst of fizz on the exhale. Double Apple: A perfectly balanced blend of crisp and juicy red and green apple flavours. Breakfast Tea: The light and aromatic taste of traditional breakfast tea. Blueberry Sour Raspberry: Sweet blueberry combined with tangy raspberry flavours given a sweet sour note. Blueberry Ice: A classic sweet and juicy blueberry flavour with a cool menthol finish. Blue Razz Lemonade: Tangy blue raspberry flavour with a fresh and zesty lemonade twist. How to Use Your Dojo Blast6000 Device: 1. Remove the silicone plug on the top of the 2ml prefilled pod and the sticker on the bottom. 2. Insert the 2ml prefilled pod into the 10ml refill container smoothly until it clicks into place. 3. Ensure the 2ml prefilled pod and the 10ml refill container are connected. 4. Insert the 10+2ml Pod & Refill into the device. 5. Enjoy vaping. 6. Press to switch between Turbo Mode and Normal Mode. Please note: Charging cable is not supplied. A USB-C cable can be purchased separately. Shop Dojo Blast 6000 Refill Pods
